page.overview:
Who is Barbara P. Covington?

Lieutenant Barbara P. Covington was a Starfleet officer during the Dominion War.

In 2374, , Starbase 129, and Starbase 153 reported her as missing in action; however, both the and reported her as killed in action. (, okudagram)
